name: qfd_coll_split_q9a-q9a-COMMIT
purpose: QE3-COLL Q leaf q9a: q9a MAIN: 3 macro columns (W sd 4x256 MY | rings 4x128 | E xf 4x128) replace the two 193-um walls; every macro free-standing (no abutment; 22-um N-S crossing gaps with 2.16-um top/bottom halo -> ~20-um std-cell crossing rows between every SRAM); pin-face halo 10.8 + ~21.7-um std-cell channel beside every SRAM pin face (W strip, two column channels, E strip); W/E buses 4 pins/um centred on the mid crossing with the SerDes inputs sr1/sr2 (E: dp/dr) in the middle so each capture flop sits beside its xsrc mux, no SRAM wall between; fill 35% (owner floor) with zero squeeze of any channel vs q8 (q8 cut channels had ~1.4 um of rows). RTL/pins/clock/reset unchanged.
